# FG-WEB-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`server-start-failed`](../../ops/runbooks/server-start-failed.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `invalid_or_duplicate_routes_are_a_startup_error` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: サーバーの設定に問題があり、起動できませんでした。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The server could not start because of a configuration problem. Contact the administrator.
- id: Server tidak dapat dijalankan karena masalah konfigurasi. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

The route registry is inconsistent: a duplicate method and path, or a path that is empty, lacks the leading '/', or has an empty segment. Detected at startup, before any request is served (a programming error in a release).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The `context` field contains `reason=` and `routes=`. Look at `app::registry()` in forge-web for the listed routes.

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the registration in forge-web and release again; nothing to change on the server.
